message.reasoning_content: Verify answer.txt content only value. Done. Could also confirm no other TOKEN= occurrences (grep -c). Let me run a verification.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "grep -c 'TOKEN=' full_output.txt; grep -o 'TOKEN=[^ ]*' full_output.txt | sed 's/^TOKEN=//' > expected.txt; diff -q expected.txt answer.txt && echo \"MATCH\"; cat answer.txt"}
